attempts.target: install_vaila_mac.sh: add local(default)/applications install-path choice for app shortcut, guard sudo, add Spotlight registration
attempts.change_summary: Moved create_app_bundle() near top of file, gated by VAILA_TEST_APP_BUNDLE_ONLY=1 test-harness hook. Added VAILA_INSTALL_PATH_CHOICE (local default | applications) with interactive prompt (default local, no sudo) when no choice supplied and stdin is a tty; non-tty/no-choice defaults to local. Guarded the /Applications sudo symlink block to only run for the 'applications' choice; SYSTEM_APPLICATIONS_DIR overridable via VAILA_TEST_APPLICATIONS_DIR (skips sudo when overridden). Added mdimport (plain, not -d1) alongside existing lsregister -f calls on both the local and system app paths for Spotlight indexing. Guarded killall Finder/Dock + full lsregister -kill rebuild + Python icon-apply step behind VAILA_TEST_APP_BUNDLE_ONLY so sandboxed checks never touch real system state. Updated final 'Ways to run vaila' echo to reflect actual choice made. Bumped header Update/Version to match vaila.py (0.3.117, 2026-08-27).
attempts.regressions: none observed against prior assertions (none existed at baseline; script had no local/applications choice at all — always unconditional sudo)

lessons: mdimport -d1 requires -t (test-import only, does not index) — real indexing is plain `mdimport <path>` (implied -i).
ruff/ty do not apply to install_vaila_mac.sh (bash, not Python) — governing check corrected to bash -n only; shellcheck not installed in this sandbox.

killall Finder/Dock and the full lsregister -kill LaunchServices rebuild are real system-wide side effects even when APP_DIR is sandboxed under a fake HOME — must be explicitly gated behind the test-harness flag, not assumed safe just because the target path is redirected.
